text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh… I shouldn't have read so much manga before going to bed…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But they were finally about to get together… I couldn't just go to sleep before that happened… Urgh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn… I'll just read one chapter tonight. Maybe two…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Mejiro Dober didn't get a very good night's rest.
